👹 ‘GREMLINS 3’ IS OFFICIALLY COMING IN 2028! 🎬🔥

After the original ‘GREMLINS’ (1984) and ‘GREMLINS 2: THE NEW BATCH’ (1990), the beloved franchise is finally returning!

The third movie was delayed from late 2027 and is now scheduled to hit theaters on October 6, 2028. 🍿

👀 Are you excited for ‘GREMLINS 3’, or do you think the franchise should have ended with the original movies? 💬
